text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The first day of the New Year.
For some reason...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
'#FirstSunrise #Sharing
#ThisYearToo #CuteCurrenChan'
Fufu, it's so gorgeous...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Watching the first sunrise of the year from the mountain peak.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Take a picture, take a picture, Big Brother!
See, Curren will hold up the first sunrise from below,
so you, Big Brother...—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Take a photo, take a photo, Big Sis!
You see, Curren will hold up the first sunrise from below,
and you can...――

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Once again, Happy New Year everyone~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to shower Curren with lots of love
this year too, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to shower Curren with lots of love
this year too, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I mean, the first sunrise of the year is super Insta-worthy~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I actually got to take some gorgeous photos, so it feels like Curren's in top form right from the new year♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I got plenty of energy
from all that sunshine power, so it worked out great!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
I need to recharge plenty.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Because Curren's path forward will be decided very soon.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren, after all...
really wants the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle this once and for all.
Is Curren truly worthy of the Tiara, or...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Fillies' Revue, which will determine her path,
will be here in the blink of an eye after New Year's.
Her determination seems to be nothing short of extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren just really wants to do her best.
Because, because...—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The biggest tiara suits Curren best, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's all~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The road seems a bit too harsh for such a motive,
but I still want to support their drive toward that goal."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Alright! We've seen the first sunrise, so let's head down the mountain.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is free after this, but...
Is there anything we should do right now for the sake of the tiara?
choice_data_list: Don't rush, just rest over the New Year
A Multifaceted Brilliance for the Tiara

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, that's so simple!
Is that really all it takes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Curren Chan has a path to victory,
it'll be in a battle of pure speed.
I told her it'd be best to hone her weapon even further.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Honing my own weapons... huh.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it!
Curren's gonna be faster than anyone♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Then, how about this?
Title: The Downhill Race!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's see who can run down the mountain faster,
Big Brother! You versus Curren!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
A race between you and Curren
to see who gets down the mountain faster!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If you chase after me, Big Brother,
it'll give me so much motivation♪
What a great idea~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If Big Sis chases after me,
it'll give Curren extra motivation, too♪
Brilliant idea~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of course, make sure you don't get hurt, okay?
I'll think about the victory conditions while we race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no way I could ever beat an Umamusume like Curren Chan,
no matter how you looked at it, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Alright, and start!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"You're slow, Big Brother!
Oh, watch out for the step!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're late, Big Sis~?
Ah, watch your step, there's a ledge!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected, or rather as predicted, it wasn't much of
a contest... and as a result, I ended up having to buy
two soft-serve ice creams from the shop at the base of the mountain.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I suppose there's no need to rush
into doing something right at the start of the new year.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: So, what are we doing after this?
choice_data_list: Maybe I should head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Where is Curren?
choice_data_list: You can do what you want.
Feel free to do what you want.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... So that means
Curren can do whatever she wants.
Hmm~..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan is staring intently at me,
looking as if she has something to say...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Still, there aren't many shops open over New Year's, though."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, there was a lovely cafe on the way up~.
I'm pretty sure that one was open!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Though, doing it alone feels a bit lonely.
I want to talk about how it felt
with whoever climbed the mountain with me, but...
choice_data_list: …Is it okay if I tag along?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha, of course♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, I've been curious about that café,
but I rarely get a chance to go up the mountain~."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's take it easy,
big brother?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's take it easy,
big sister?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we took a nice, long rest
until Curren Chan was fully satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...I see!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: In other words, Onii-chan, you want Curren to shine even brighter, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: In other words, Onee-chan, you want Curren to shine even brighter, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Which means we're going on a date right now
to find that clue togetherâª

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I mean, isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to shine even brighter"...
Come on, not even TV dramas
use lines like that these days.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
For Curren to shine,
a bit of excitement is necessary.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So Onii-chan,
make Curren's heart race a whole, whole lot, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So Onee-chan,
make Curren's heart race a whole, whole lot, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After all was said and done,
it seems Curren Chan grasped a hint to her brilliance.
